| `linkItem`                              | `menuitem`, on a native `<a href>`, from Base UI                           | Its text, the caller's `children`                           | none                                                                                                      |
| `checkboxItem`                          | `menuitemcheckbox`, from Base UI                                           | Its text, the caller's `children`                           | `aria-checked`; `aria-disabled` while disabled                                                            |
| `radioGroup`                            | `group`, from Base UI                                                      | `aria-labelledby` its `groupLabel`, the caller's `label`    | `aria-disabled` while disabled                                                                            |
| `radioItem`                             | `menuitemradio`, from Base UI                                              | Its text, the caller's `children`                           | `aria-checked`; `aria-disabled` while disabled                                                            |
| `group`                                 | `group`, from Base UI                                                      | `aria-labelledby` its `groupLabel`, the caller's `label`    | none                                                                                                      |
| `groupLabel`                            | none: `aria-hidden="true"`, from Base UI, read as the group's name instead | none                                                        | none                                                                                                      |
| `separator`                             | `separator`, from Base UI                                                  | none                                                        | `aria-orientation="horizontal"`                                                                           |
| `submenu`                               | `menuitem` with `aria-haspopup="menu"`, from Base UI                       | Its text, the caller's `label`                              | `aria-expanded` while closed (Base UI drops it while open, for VoiceOver); `aria-disabled` while disabled |
| `submenuPopup`                          | `menu`, from Base UI                                                       | `aria-labelledby` its row                                   | none                                                                                                      |
| `startIcon`, `chevron`, both indicators | none: `aria-hidden="true"`                                                 | none                                                        | none                                                                                                      |

What axe won't catch, from the contract, each with how this component meets it:

- [ ] Everything the eye is told, the ear is told, for every shape each prop accepts: each row is named by its label; the start icon, the chevron, the box and the tick are `aria-hidden`, and what they show is announced by the row's role and state: `menuitemcheckbox` with `aria-checked` for the box, `menuitemradio` with `aria-checked` for the tick, `aria-haspopup="menu"` for the chevron; a group's label is its name; disabled is `aria-disabled`.
- [ ] Every landmark and named region has an accessible name: the menu is named by its trigger and a submenu by its row, through `aria-labelledby`, and every group with a label by it; the stories give every group a label but the `Submenu` story's radio group, whose choice the submenu's row, "Language", already names, as `MenuRadioGroup`'s `label` row allows.
- [ ] Every default label can be overridden: none here; Menu owns no strings.
- [ ] Every shape the type accepts renders, in every variant: `trigger`, `children`, `label` and `startIcon` render a string, an element and a list alike; a long word in a label wraps (CR-11).
- [ ] A hidden copy kept for animation is `aria-hidden`, and a collapsed region is `inert`: none here; the closed menu renders nothing, and the unchecked box is a mark inside its row, `aria-hidden` like the checked one.
- [ ] Native semantics first: a native `<button>` trigger and `<a href>` link items, and Base UI's `menu`, `menuitem`, `menuitemcheckbox`, `menuitemradio`, `group` and `separator` roles, with no ARIA of Perron's own.
- [ ] Focus moves in reading order and returns on close: the arrow keys move through the items in document order, the order on screen; opening from the keys focuses the first item; closing, by any reason, returns focus to the trigger, also for a menu open at first render (CR-5), and closing a submenu returns it to the submenu's row.
- [ ] Every target is at least `size.target-min` square: the smallest target is a row, at least `size.target-min` tall and as wide as the popup.
- [ ] Loops stop when the system asks for less motion: none here; the menu has no loop and no transition (CR-12).

## Owned strings

No owned strings: every word comes from the caller, as the trigger's content, each row's `children` or `label`, and each group's `label`. The box, the tick and the chevron say nothing of their own: the rows' roles and states announce them.

## Component rules

Rules for this component alone, numbered so the build and the review can cite them.

- **CR-1.** Base UI's menu already gives the opening, the placing, the arrow keys, Home and End, typeahead, the highlight on hover, the checkbox and radio state, the submenus, Esc, the outside press, the focus return and every role and state, so the components rebuild none of it and add no key or pointer handlers.
- **CR-2.** `Menu` renders `Menu.Root` around `Menu.Trigger` (`render={trigger}`) and `Menu.Portal`, which holds `Menu.Positioner` and then `Menu.Popup`, which holds the caller's `children`. `MenuSubmenu` renders `Menu.SubmenuRoot` around `Menu.SubmenuTrigger` (the start icon, the label and the chevron, the `chevron-right` `<svg>` inside its `<span class="pn-MenuSubmenu-chevron" aria-hidden="true">` holder, which [Icons](../foundations/icons.md) asks to take the icon's size and colour, never the `<svg>` itself) and `Menu.Portal`, `Menu.Positioner` and `Menu.Popup`, which holds its `children`. `MenuGroup` and `MenuRadioGroup` render `Menu.GroupLabel` first, when `label` is given, then their `children`. `MenuCheckboxItem` and `MenuRadioItem` render their label span, then their indicator. The DOM order is the reading order and the order on screen.
- **CR-3.** Each of the nine takes `{...rest}` before its own attributes, and its own props out of `rest` first, so none reaches the DOM: Menu's `trigger`, `children`, `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpen`, `onClose`, `disabled` and `slotProps`; a row's `startIcon`, `children` and `disabled`, and a submenu's `label`; the checkbox item's `checked`, `defaultChecked`, `onChange` and `slotProps`; the radio group's `label`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `disabled` and `slotProps`; the radio item's `value`, `disabled` and `slotProps`; the group's `label` and `slotProps`. Inherited Base UI props, such as `finalFocus`, `closeOnClick` and `openOnHover`, stay in `rest`, keeping Base UI's defaults. `ref`, `style` and `data-testid` land on each component's root, and `className` is merged after its `pn-` class. Each `slotProps` value is merged with Base UI's `mergeProps` (`@base-ui/react/merge-props`), the component's own props last, so a caller's class sits beside the part's `pn-` class; a part the component sets nothing on but its class, the portals, the group labels and the submenu's popup, is spread as it is, `{...slotProps?.portal}`, as the contract's [Customising](README.md#customising) rule asks.
- **CR-4.** Menu turns Base UI's `onOpenChange(open, details)` into `onOpen(details.event, details)` when `open` is `true` and `onClose(details.event, details.reason, details)` when it is `false`; `MenuCheckboxItem` turns `onCheckedChange(checked, details)` into `onChange(details.event, checked, details)`, and `MenuRadioGroup` `onValueChange(value, details)` into `onChange(details.event, value, details)`. None exposes Base UI's `onOpenChange`, `onCheckedChange` or `onValueChange`.
- **CR-5.** Menu gives `Menu.Trigger` an id (the `trigger` element's own `id`, then `slotProps.trigger.id`, or one from React's `useId`) and passes it to `Menu.Root` as `defaultTriggerId`, or as `triggerId` when `open` is set, as the Base UI reference says for a menu open at first render or controlled, so the popup is named by the trigger and focus returns to it when such a menu closes.
- **CR-6.** `MenuItem`, `MenuLinkItem`, `MenuCheckboxItem`, `MenuRadioItem`, `MenuSeparator`, `MenuGroup`, `MenuRadioGroup` and `MenuSubmenu` only render inside a `Menu`'s popup or a `MenuSubmenu`'s, and `MenuRadioItem` only inside a `MenuRadioGroup`: Base UI's parts read their context. Every story renders them there.
- **CR-7.** The five rows share one look, written once over their five classes; the states keep a row's geometry: hover, highlighted, pressed, selected, open and disabled change colours only, never the height, padding, gap or radius. Hover is read inside `@media (hover: hover)`; the highlighted fill is on `[data-highlighted]` outside it, so the keys and a touch show it; the pressed layer is on `:active`, outside the query and after both, so it wins under the pointer and a touch press shows it too; none applies to a disabled row, since a row focusable when disabled still matches `:hover` and `:active` and takes `data-highlighted`.
- **CR-8.** The box is the `CheckboxIndicator` part, in `packages/perron/src/parts/CheckboxIndicator/` as Checkbox's build left it, and the tick the `SelectedMark` part, in `packages/perron/src/parts/SelectedMark/` as Select's build left it, each rendered through its Base UI part's `render`. The box is `<Menu.CheckboxItemIndicator keepMounted render={(props, state) => <CheckboxIndicator {...props} mark={state.checked ? 'tick' : undefined} />} />`, written once outside the component, as the [Checkbox](checkbox.md) spec's CR-4 renders it, the part unchanged: it reads `data-checked`, `data-unchecked` and `data-disabled` from the props Base UI passes, and its hover from the row that holds it (`[role]:hover >`, the row's `menuitemcheckbox` role), so the box is a direct child of the row. The tick is `<Menu.RadioItemIndicator render={<SelectedMark />} />`, a `<span class="pn-SelectedMark">` holding the `tick` icon inlined from its file, unchanged but for `width` and `height`, with `perron-icon`, `aria-hidden="true"` and `focusable="false"`, at `icon.size.325` in `currentColor`, as the `CheckboxIndicator` draws its mark. Only the parts' folders hold `pn-CheckboxIndicator`, `pn-SelectedMark` and the `tick` icon, which the contract's [Shared parts](README.md#shared-parts) table gives to both, and Menu's CSS sets only their place in the row (`margin-inline-start: auto` at the row's end, `flex: none`, and the `margin-block` that centres each on the label's first line), never their colours or their size, but under forced colours, where a highlighted row hands its unticked box back to the system's colours with `forced-color-adjust: auto` (CR-13). The contract's "Composed in" cells already name `Menu.CheckboxItemIndicator` and `Menu.RadioItemIndicator`. Menu composes the existing `tick` icon, whose `icons.json` entry already names the chosen option in a list, unchanged. The build adds only the `chevron-right` icon to `packages/perron/icons/` and `icons.json`, drawn on the 16 px grid for `icon.size.400`, inlined in the submenu's row inside its `chevron` holder span (CR-2).
- **CR-9.** The popup opens below its trigger aligned to the trigger's start edge, `space.100` away, with a submenu at the end of its row whose first item lines up with that row. Menu passes `align: 'start'`, a `sideOffset` of `space.100` and a `collisionPadding` of `size.panel-gap` to `Menu.Positioner`, and `MenuSubmenu` passes `alignOffset` of minus `space.100` plus `border.width.025` and the same `collisionPadding` to its positioner, keeping Base UI's `side` (`'bottom'`, and `'inline-end'` for a submenu) and the submenu's `sideOffset` of 0, each length read once with `tokenValue('--perron-…')` and kept, `size.panel-gap` through the shared `positionerOffsets` helper that Popover, Tooltip and MapTooltip read, with Base UI's own defaults until they can be read. Each positioner merges the caller's `slotProps.positioner` first and Menu's own props last, each of them the caller's value where it gives one, as Popover's does, so a caller's value wins over each. A menu reads as its trigger's when the two share an edge, where Base UI's default `'center'` sets it off from a button at the screen's edge; the gap is the Popups' own `space.100` padding and MapTooltip reads its offset the same way; a submenu pulled up by its popup's padding and edge puts its first row level with the row that opened it; and Base UI flips either side when there is no room.
- **CR-10.** The positioners take `z-index.dialog`, as everything in a portal does, so a submenu opened last paints over its menu. Menu's CSS never redefines a token: the portals sit outside every themed container but `<body>`.
- **CR-11.** A row's label grows (`flex: 1`, `min-inline-size: 0`) and its start icon, box, tick and chevron keep their size (`flex: none`) and sit on the label's first line (`align-items: flex-start` on the row, and on each a `margin-block` of `calc((1lh - <its size>) / 2)`), so they stay level with its first words when it wraps. Long words wrap in a row, its label and a group label (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`), so a long Danish word fits a 320 px screen: the popup grows with its longest label until `--available-width` runs out, and the label then wraps inside it.
- **CR-12.** The menu opens and closes at once: no `duration.*` token fits a popup's entrance, so the CSS has no transition and styles neither `data-starting-style` nor `data-ending-style`, as Dialog and SearchField.
- **CR-13.** The popups draw their `border.width.025` edge as a border, and the separator its hairline as a border, so Windows' forced colours keep an edge round each popup and between groups when they drop the glass; a highlighted row takes `Highlight` and `HighlightText` there; the box keeps the `CheckboxIndicator` part's own forced-colours rules, `Highlight` with a `HighlightText` tick while ticked and `GrayText` while disabled ([Checkbox](checkbox.md)'s CR-11); and the radio item's tick, drawn in `currentColor`, takes the row's system colour.
- **CR-14.** The portal renders nothing on the server, so the contract story's owned-strings check, which renders to static markup, sees only the trigger. Menu's own stories check the open popup's words in the live DOM instead: `expectOwnedStrings(popup.outerHTML, locale, callerWords)` in English and in Danish, which finds no word of Menu's own.
- **CR-15.** The stories' meta sets `parameters: { docs: { story: { inline: false, height: '480px' } } }`, as the contract's [Stories](README.md#stories) asks of an overlay, and each story but `Disabled` opens its menu at first render with `defaultOpen`, beside the trigger that opens it again. Each `play` finds the popup through `screen` and ends at rest: the menu closed, focus back on the trigger, where it started, then blurred.

Menu's root, the popup, portals to `<body>`, and only after the portal mounts, so it is not inside the story's canvas. Menu meets the contract story's Root rule with no exception: the contract story looks the root up in the whole document, as it does for Dialog.

## Stories

The deferred design's page draws two components: the open menu, with no variant property, its one variant `Default`, and its row, with one property, `State` (`default`, `highlighted`, `disabled`, `selected`). Each story is named by its variant name (`penpot/README.md`, "Conventions"), the row's prefixed `Item`, as the Toolbar spec prefixes its button's, since the Penpot conventions name a variant by its property values alone. The other stories show the other components and the behaviour beside them, which their `play` tests check.

Each story renders the menu beside its trigger, a [Button](button.md) "Map options", in a `PerronProvider` in English, with `fn()` handlers for `onOpen`, `onClose` and every `onClick` and `onChange`. The `Default` story's args, which the contract story renders, hold every word the caller gives: the trigger "Map options" and three items with `packages/perron/icons/`'s icons drawn on the 16 px grid for the start icon's `icon.size.400`, "Centre the map" (`locate`), "Zoom in" (`plus`) and "Zoom out" (`minus`) ([Content design](../content-design.md)). In each story every row has a start icon or none does, so every label starts at one edge. The highlighted story renders at rest: the visual check drives the state, and its `play` checks it.

| Story             | Shows                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `play` test                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Default`         | The one variant of the menu, the contract story's: open with `defaultOpen` beside its trigger, three items with start icons                                                                                               | The popup has the `menu` role and is named "Map options" by its trigger, whose `aria-haspopup` is `menu`; Escape closes it, `onClose` gets `'escape-key'` and focus returns to the trigger, whose `aria-expanded` is `false`; Enter on the trigger opens it, calls `onOpen` and focuses "Centre the map"; ArrowDown moves to "Zoom in", End to "Zoom out", ArrowDown wraps to the first, Home stays there, and typing "z" moves to "Zoom in"; Enter runs its `onClick` once, closes with `'item-press'` and focus returns to the trigger; the open popup's markup passes `expectOwnedStrings` in English and Danish |
| `ItemDefault`     | The row at rest: one item, "Zoom in", in an open menu                                                                                                                                                                     | none                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `ItemHighlighted` | The row highlighted: the `Default` menu, its second item under the pointer or the keys                                                                                                                                    | Hovering "Zoom in" gives it `data-highlighted` and focus and the `color.surface.hover` fill; ArrowDown from the trigger's open lands on the first item with `:focus-visible` and the ring; pressing it lays the `color.surface.selected` fill, in a rule after the hover rule and apart from the hover fill, and the cursor is `pointer`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |

## Do and don't

For a caller using the component, with the reason.

| Do                                                                                                                                                                                  | Don't                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Pass the button that opens the menu as `trigger`, with words that name the menu, such as "Map options", or an IconButton with an `aria-label`                                       | Open a menu from a button placed beside it with `open` alone: the button loses `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`, and the menu its name                                    |
| Set `slotProps.trigger.nativeButton` to `false` when `trigger` is not a `<button>`, as Base UI warns                                                                                | Pass a link as the trigger: a link goes somewhere, and a menu opens over the screen                                                                                          |
| Disable the menu with `disabled` on the Menu                                                                                                                                        | Disable only the trigger element: Base UI's trigger stays enabled and the menu still opens                                                                                   |
| Put actions in `MenuItem`s, links in `MenuLinkItem`s, settings in `MenuCheckboxItem`s and one choice in a `MenuRadioGroup` with a `label`                                           | Put a Button, a Switch or a plain `<a>` in the popup: it falls out of the arrow-key order and gets no menu role                                                              |
| Keep a checkbox item's words the same on and off, such as "Show stop names", and let its box and `aria-checked` say the state                                                       | Change a setting's words when it turns on, or use a checkbox item for an action                                                                                              |
| Name each group with `label`, in sentence case, and divide groups with `MenuSeparator`                                                                                              | Put a heading or a styled `<div>` in the popup as a label: it isn't tied to its group, and the arrow keys would skip a group they can't name                                 |
| Give every row in a menu a start icon, drawn for `icon.size.400`, or give none of them one; a checkbox or radio item takes none, so a menu that holds one gives its other rows none | Give some rows an icon and leave others without, or use an icon drawn for `icon.size.450`: the labels start at two edges, and a scaled-down icon's stroke falls under 1.5 px |
| Keep a disabled item in place, so the person learns it exists, and keep menus short, a submenu one level deep at most                                                               | Hide and show items as the state changes, or nest submenus: rows that move and deep paths are hard to follow on a phone                                                      |
| Use a menu for a short list of actions and settings that open from one button                                                                                                       | Use a menu to choose a form's value or to search a long list: that is a Select or a SearchField, which submit and filter                                                     |
| Open a menu from a toolbar by passing a `ToolbarButton` as `trigger`, so it joins the toolbar's arrow-key order                                                                     | Put a Menu's trigger beside a toolbar's buttons as a plain Button: it adds a tab stop and falls out of the toolbar's arrow keys                                              |
| Let the menu take `z-index.dialog`, its place against the trigger and its glass                                                                                                     | Set a `z-index`, a position or a background on the popup: it would fall under another overlay or leave the Popups family                                                     |

title: Sheet
markdown:
# Sheet

A panel that slides in from the edge of the screen and floats over the map: the overview sheet and the detail panel on a wide screen, and the bottom sheet they become on a phone ([Layout](../foundations/layout.md#page-shell)).

<!-- run notes -->

The design is deferred (`docs/adr/0010-unattended-runs-with-design-deferred.md`): this spec decides the variant property, the parts and the token of every part, from the contract, the foundations, the tokens and the Base UI reference. A later design run can change them.

## Anatomy

Penpot page `Components/Sheet`. Family: `Panels`. Shared parts: `CloseButton`.

| Part (Penpot layer) | What it is                                                                                          | Base UI part                                                    | Class               | `slotProps` key |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------- |
| `root`              | The panel itself: the dialog, holding the header and the content                                    | `Drawer.Popup`                                                  | `pn-Sheet`          | none            |
| `trigger`           | The caller's button that opens the sheet, when the caller gives one                                 | `Drawer.Trigger`                                                | none: the caller's  | `trigger`       |
| `portal`            | Moves the sheet to the end of `<body>`, or to the caller's container; draws nothing                 | `Drawer.Portal`                                                 | none                | `portal`        |
| `backdrop`          | The scrim behind a modal sheet; not rendered when the sheet is not modal                            | `Drawer.Backdrop`                                               | `pn-Sheet-backdrop` | `backdrop`      |
| `viewport`          | The fixed layer that places the panel against its edge, `size.panel-gap` in from the screen's edges | `Drawer.Viewport`                                               | `pn-Sheet-viewport` | `viewport`      |
| `header`            | The row along the top of the panel: the title, then the close button                                | none: a `div` that only lays out the title and the close button | `pn-Sheet-header`   | none            |
| `title`             | The sheet's name, the heading that labels the dialog                                                | `Drawer.Title`                                                  | `pn-Sheet-title`    | `title`         |
| `close`             | The icon button that closes the sheet, the `CloseButton` shared part                                | `Drawer.Close`                                                  | `pn-Sheet-close`    | `close`         |
| `content`           | The caller's children, below the header; it scrolls on its own, so the header stays in place        | `Drawer.Content`                                                | `pn-Sheet-content`  | `content`       |

`Drawer.Description` is not one of the sheet's parts: `packages/perron/components.json` leaves it out, and a sheet's body is the caller's own content.

## Base UI parts

## Component rules

Rules for this component alone, numbered so the build and the review can cite them.

- **CR-1.** Base UI's Drawer already handles focus moving in and back, the focus trap and scroll lock of a modal sheet, Esc, outside presses, swipes and snap points, so the component rebuilds none of them.
- **CR-2.** The root is `Drawer.Popup`: `ref`, `className` (`pn-Sheet` first, then the caller's) and the rest props reach it, the rest spread before the component's own attributes. The other parts are reached only through `slotProps`, merged with `mergeProps`, the component's own props last.
- **CR-3.** `anchor`, MUI Drawer's name for the edge, maps to `swipeDirection`, with no `top` until a screen needs one: `left` to `'left'`, `right` to `'right'`, `bottom` to `'down'`. The root and the viewport carry `data-anchor` with its value, the default included, and the CSS places and slides the sheet from it: `.pn-Sheet[data-anchor='bottom']`.
- **CR-4.** While `modal` is false, the component passes `disablePointerDismissal`, renders no `Drawer.Backdrop`, and the viewport takes `pointer-events: none` with the root back on `auto`, so the map under and beside the sheet stays usable. While `modal` is true, the backdrop renders with `color.scrim`, and a press on it closes the sheet with reason `outside-press`.
- **CR-5.** The viewport and the backdrop take `z-index.dialog`, as everything in a portal does. A pattern that lays a sheet among the map screen's panels sets its own `z-index.*` through `slotProps.viewport`'s `className`.
- **CR-6.** The component holds no media query for the phone: it sizes to its viewport, and the screen picks `anchor` `bottom` under `breakpoint.phone`.
- **CR-7.** The root is a flex column: the header keeps its height, and the content takes the rest, with `overflow-y: auto` and `overscroll-behavior: contain`, so a long body scrolls under a header that stays.
- **CR-8.** A side sheet moves with `transform: translateX(var(--drawer-swipe-movement-x))`, and a bottom sheet with `transform: translateY(calc(var(--drawer-snap-point-offset) + var(--drawer-swipe-movement-y)))`. Under `[data-starting-style]` and `[data-ending-style]` it sits off its edge: a side sheet by its own width and the `size.panel-gap` it keeps from the edge, `translateX(calc(-100% - size.panel-gap))` from the left and `translateX(calc(100% + size.panel-gap))` from the right, and a bottom sheet by its own height, `translateY(100%)`, with its `padding-block-end` at 0. At rest, a bottom sheet's `padding-block-end` takes the same `calc()` as its `translateY`, so the scrolling body ends on screen, and keeps on screen, at every snap point. Base UI's `--drawer-*` properties are read, never set, by the component's CSS.
- **CR-9.** The snap point props reach `Drawer.Root` only with `anchor` `bottom`. With no `snapPoints`, a bottom sheet snaps to `size.sheet-peek` and to `1`, and opens at the peek. The peek is read at runtime from the token's custom property, `getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--perron-size-sheet-peek')`, a `px` string Base UI takes as a snap point, once, when a bottom sheet first renders.
- **CR-10.** `onOpen(event, details)` and `onClose(event, reason, details)` are adapted from `onOpenChange` inside the component, with `event` as `details.event` and `reason` as `details.reason`; `onSnapPointChange(event, snapPoint, details)` is adapted the same way. Neither of Base UI's callbacks is exposed.
- **CR-11.** The close button is the `CloseButton` shared part, rendered through `Drawer.Close`, after the title in the header. Its label is `useOwnedStrings({ close: closeLabel }).close`. When the part's folder does not exist yet, the build adds it, as the contract's [Shared parts](README.md#shared-parts) say, drawn by the `close` rows of [Tokens](#tokens), with the `close` icon from `packages/perron/icons/close.svg`.
- **CR-12.** The portal renders nothing in static markup, so the contract's `OwnedStrings` story sees only the trigger. A `play` test runs `expectOwnedStrings` over the open sheet's markup in `da`, with the story's `title` and `children` as the caller's words.
- **CR-13.** The `Left` story's args hold `defaultOpen: true`, so the contract story finds its root, the popup, with the `ref` and the `data-testid` on it.
